name: Card Data 12
definition: Non-protected sensitive data associated with the card or payment token performing the transaction.

PAN.name: PAN
PAN.definition: Primary Account Number (PAN) of the card or a surrogate of the PAN such as a payment token.

ProtectedPAN.name: Protected PAN
ProtectedPAN.definition: To indicate whether the PAN is using ProtectedData for encryption or not.|False: The PAN is used in plain text |True: The PAN is encrypted by using ProtectedData|Default: False

CardSequenceNumber.name: Card Sequence Number
CardSequenceNumber.definition: Distinguishes between instances of the same payment card.

EffectiveDate.name: Effective Date
EffectiveDate.definition: Date as from which the card can be used, expressed in one of the following formats: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM, YY-MM-DD.

ExpiryDate.name: Expiry Date
ExpiryDate.definition: Expiry date of the card or payment token.

Track3.name: Track 3
Track3.definition: ISO track 3 issued from the magnetic stripe card or from the ICC if the magnetic stripe was not read. The content is conform to ISO 4909, removing beginning and ending sentinels and longitudinal redundancy check characters.

PaymentAccountReference.name: Payment Account Reference
PaymentAccountReference.definition: Unique non-financial reference assigned to a given PAN. May be used to link the transaction activity to that PAN.

PANAccountRange.name: PAN Account Range
PANAccountRange.definition: Leading digits of the PAN that identifies the card portfolio (for example, Issuer Identification Number). This data should not to be presented to the card acceptor or its environment. (for example, acquirer should not to send or make available to merchant).

PANFourLastDigits.name: PAN Four Last Digits
PANFourLastDigits.definition: Last four digits of the PAN.

Country.name: Country
Country.definition: Country code assigned to the card by the card issuer.|ISO 8583 bit 20

Currency.name: Currency
Currency.definition: Currency code assigned to the card by the card issuer.
